people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And he set the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
